gloss: person of great talent; great vessel

definitions.gloss: person of great talent; person of great capacity
definitions.explanation: A person of outstanding ability and breadth, likened to a large vessel. The literal sense of a large container survives mainly in set phrases.

examples.english: He is a person of great talent.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}{選手|せんしゅ}の{大器|たいき}ぶりが{注目|ちゅうもく}される。
examples.english: The young player's great promise is drawing attention.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は{目立|めだ}たなかったが、{今|いま}や{球界|きゅうかい}を{代表|だいひょう}する{大器|たいき}となった。
examples.english: He didn't stand out when young, but has become one of the baseball world's leading talents.

notes:
Composed of {大|たい} (great) + {器|き} (vessel, capacity). Most familiar from the idiom {大器晩成|たいきばんせい} (great talents mature late).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大器|たいき}の{片鱗|へんりん}: a glimpse of great talent
- {大器晩成|たいきばんせい}: great talents mature late

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逸材|いつざい}: person of exceptional talent — emphasizes rarity and being hard to find
- {人材|じんざい}: talented person, human resource — a generally capable person, less exceptional
